tamara:O4.tamara.after.text: So many letters in one year… And here that one year was twenty. How can that be?
tamara:O4.tamara.after.voice_text: So many letters in one year… And here that one year was twenty. How can that be?

tamara:Z1.tamara.after.speaker: tamara
tamara:Z1.tamara.after.text: You have the key. I'm at the post office if you need me.
tamara:Z1.tamara.after.voice_text: [warmly] You have the key. I'm at the post office if you need me.

tamara:Z1.tamara.late.speaker: tamara
tamara:Z1.tamara.late.text: Don't blame yourself, my dear. You'd have sat by the water all year, like Pelageya. I wrote so you wouldn't come in vain.
tamara:Z1.tamara.late.voice_text: Don't blame yourself, my dear. You'd have sat by the water all year, like Pelageya. I wrote so you wouldn't come in vain.

tamara:Z1.tamara.school.speaker: tamara
tamara:Z1.tamara.school.text: One school for both banks. We used to take our children over the bridge. And now, a whole year with no one to teach them.
tamara:Z1.tamara.school.voice_text: One school for both banks. We used to take our children over the bridge. And now, a whole year with no one to teach them.

tamara:Z1.tamara.sheet.speaker: tamara
tamara:Z1.tamara.sheet.text: Dunya left it here as she went: send it to the district office, she said. That night came the flood. Here it lies.
tamara:Z1.tamara.sheet.voice_text: Dunya left it here as she went: send it to the district office, she said. That night came the flood. Here it lies.

tikhon:H1.after_mirror.tikhon_1.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.after_mirror.tikhon_1.text: Did you see Nina? All grey… Then the mistress must have grown old there, too.
tikhon:H1.after_mirror.tikhon_1.voice_text: Did you see Nina? All grey… Then the mistress must have grown old there, too.

tikhon:H1.after_mirror.tikhon_2.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.after_mirror.tikhon_2.text: How, how… Lie down and sleep, that's how. I sleep every night, and the world's still standing. While you're awake, get on with things. I'll mind the stove.
tikhon:H1.after_mirror.tikhon_2.voice_text: How, how… Lie down and sleep, that's how. I sleep every night, and the world's still standing. While you're awake, get on with things. I'll mind the stove.

tikhon:H1.shelf.react_b.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.shelf.react_b.text: So what? A sleeping mat counts as furniture, too.
tikhon:H1.shelf.react_b.voice_text: So what? A sleeping mat counts as furniture, too.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.after_dunya.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.after_dunya.text: Lying here. No one to wait for — so I just lie here. Stove's burning, pot's in its place… The mistress would say: that's something.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.after_dunya.voice_text: [thoughtful] Lying here. No one to wait for — so I just lie here. Stove's burning, pot's in its place… The mistress would say: that's something.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.ask_shelf.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.ask_shelf.text: Will you hang that shelf? There, on the sleeping ledge. Am I meant to hammer it up with my paws?
tikhon:H1.tikhon.ask_shelf.voice_text: [playful] Will you hang that shelf? There, on the sleeping ledge. Am I meant to hammer it up with my paws?

tikhon:H1.tikhon.before_met.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.before_met.text: Damp in here. Light the stove first — then we'll talk.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.before_met.voice_text: [grumbling] Damp in here. Light the stove first — then we'll talk.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.before_met_scarf.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.before_met_scarf.text: Get that wet shawl off the sleeping ledge. It's making the whole house damp.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.before_met_scarf.voice_text: [grumbling] Get that wet shawl off the sleeping ledge. It's making the whole house damp.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.before_met_shutter.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.before_met_shutter.text: Fire's lit. Good. Now open the shutter: it's as dark as the space beneath the stove.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.before_met_shutter.voice_text: [grumbling] Fire's lit. Good. Now open the shutter: it's as dark as the space beneath the stove.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.bell.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.bell.text: The bell's from the mill. An odd one. Rings somewhere else.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.bell.voice_text: [sarcastic] The bell's from the mill. An odd one. Rings somewhere else.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.bundle.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.bundle.text: Nina's mirror is on the workbench, wrapped in a cloth. Leave it alone: the frame's barely holding together.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.bundle.voice_text: [sarcastic] Nina's mirror is on the workbench, wrapped in a cloth. Leave it alone: the frame's barely holding together.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.cream.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.cream.text: If she found the sour cream.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.cream.voice_text: If she found the sour cream.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.cream_3.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.cream_3.text: On my whiskers. Nothing left to find in the pot.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.cream_3.voice_text: On my whiskers. Nothing left to find in the pot.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.door.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.door.text: From the school — Nina asked for it.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.door.voice_text: From the school — Nina asked for it.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.duty.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.duty.text: The whole house. Pot's part of it.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.duty.voice_text: The whole house. Pot's part of it.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.duty_3.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.duty_3.text: A weighty one. That's why I lie down.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.duty_3.voice_text: A weighty one. That's why I lie down.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.first_name.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.first_name.text: Tikhon. Keeper of the stove. A demanding post: lie here and see it doesn't go cold.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.first_name.voice_text: [sarcastic] Tikhon. Keeper of the stove. A demanding post: lie here and see it doesn't go cold.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.first_stove.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.first_stove.text: The stove's here too, of course.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.first_stove.voice_text: [sarcastic] The stove's here too, of course.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.hear.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.hear.text: She'll scold you all the same. Grown or not.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.hear.voice_text: She'll scold you all the same. Grown or not.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.home.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.home.text: And tell us to eat while it's hot.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.home.voice_text: And tell us to eat while it's hot.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.home_3.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.home_3.text: Where do you think you are?
tikhon:H1.tikhon.home_3.voice_text: Where do you think you are?

tikhon:H1.tikhon.leave.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.leave.text: I'm not asleep. I'm on duty lying down.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.leave.voice_text: [sleepy] I'm not asleep. I'm on duty lying down.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.mend.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.mend.text: Whatever people brought: doors, mirrors, that bell. Said a thing remembers its place; it only needs a little help. But she couldn't hang my shelf in a whole year.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.mend.voice_text: [sarcastic] Whatever people brought: doors, mirrors, that bell. Said a thing remembers its place; it only needs a little help. But she couldn't hang my shelf in a whole year.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.night.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.night.text: All night. Didn't close an eye. Well, one — the other was on duty. I work quite comfortably lying down.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.night.voice_text: [sleepy] All night. Didn't close an eye. Well, one — the other was on duty. I work quite comfortably lying down.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.nina.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.nina.text: Nina? I remember her as a girl. Braids like yours. Came to see the mistress on Saturdays. Never brought a single pie — I remember that still.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.nina.voice_text: [playful] Nina? I remember her as a girl. Braids like yours. Came to see the mistress on Saturdays. Never brought a single pie — I remember that still.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.quiet.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.quiet.text: Dunya liked sitting quietly by the stove, too.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.quiet.voice_text: Dunya liked sitting quietly by the stove, too.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.quiet_3.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.quiet_3.text: I did. Only grumbled when necessary. Once an hour, no more.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.quiet_3.voice_text: I did. Only grumbled when necessary. Once an hour, no more.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.snow_3.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.snow_3.text: I can be surprised. A pie with no filling would do it.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.snow_3.voice_text: I can be surprised. A pie with no filling would do it.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.spoons_a.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.spoons_a.text: Outplay me, will she! Ha… Listen, then. Let's see if you can repeat it.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.spoons_a.voice_text: Outplay me, will she! Ha… Listen, then. Let's see if you can repeat it.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.spoons_done.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.spoons_done.text: That will do. Worth a little sour cream… if there were any to be had.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.spoons_done.voice_text: That will do. Worth a little sour cream… if there were any to be had.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.spoons_quit.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.spoons_quit.text: Tired? Thought so. Not as easy as lying on a stove, is it?
tikhon:H1.tikhon.spoons_quit.voice_text: Tired? Thought so. Not as easy as lying on a stove, is it?

tikhon:H1.tikhon.stove_mirror.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.stove_mirror.text: A little round mirror in a wooden frame. That day, the mistress took it down and wrapped it in a shawl. A gift for her sister, she said. Took it with her when she left.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.stove_mirror.voice_text: [thoughtful] A little round mirror in a wooden frame. That day, the mistress took it down and wrapped it in a shawl. A gift for her sister, she said. Took it with her when she left.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.supper.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.supper.text: At supper she told me to keep quiet.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.supper.voice_text: At supper she told me to keep quiet.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.tamara.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.tamara.text: Wednesdays. Cabbage soup, porridge. Fish pie on feast days. A kind woman. Stingy with the salt.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.tamara.voice_text: [playful] Wednesdays. Cabbage soup, porridge. Fish pie on feast days. A kind woman. Stingy with the salt.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.tea.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.tea.text: Here it was Dunya who scolded her.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.tea.voice_text: Here it was Dunya who scolded her.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.tea_3.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.tea_3.text: Letting her tea go cold while she fussed over exercise books.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.tea_3.voice_text: Letting her tea go cold while she fussed over exercise books.

tikhon:H1.tikhon.water.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H1.tikhon.water.text: Let it fall. It can manage without you. I'd like some peace by the stove: first the damp, then that bell. And you've only just arrived! …Why are you lugging that clamp about? Your mama's mirror is on the workbench, in a cloth. The frame's barely holding together.
tikhon:H1.tikhon.water.voice_text: [grumbling] Let it fall. It can manage without you. I'd like some peace by the stove: first the damp, then that bell. And you've only just arrived! …Why are you lugging that clamp about? Your mama's mirror is on the workbench, in a cloth. The frame's barely holding together.

tikhon:H2d.nina_mirror.watch_again.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:H2d.nina_mirror.watch_again.text: Your watch against the glass again? Compare all you like — it still runs faster over there. Go and do something useful.
tikhon:H2d.nina_mirror.watch_again.voice_text: [grumbling] Your watch against the glass again? Compare all you like — it still runs faster over there. Go and do something useful.

tikhon:mech.rhythm.good_2.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:mech.rhythm.good_2.text: All right, you have an ear. Last one — a little trickier.
tikhon:mech.rhythm.good_2.voice_text: All right, you have an ear. Last one — a little trickier.

tikhon:mech.rhythm.miss_1.speaker: tikhon
tikhon:mech.rhythm.miss_1.text: Missed. Got a tin ear? Listen again.
tikhon:mech.rhythm.miss_1.voice_text: Missed. Got a tin ear? Listen again.

ulyana:O1d.ulyana.after.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.after.text: All right. I'll draw something else on the bird.
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.after.voice_text: All right. I'll draw something else on the bird.

ulyana:O1d.ulyana.hat_b.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.hat_b.text: I drew its boots. Granny left those, too. That makes it our bird — yours and mine.
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.hat_b.voice_text: I drew its boots. Granny left those, too. That makes it our bird — yours and mine.

ulyana:O1d.ulyana.hat_q.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.hat_q.text: Agata, did you draw the bird's cap? Really? I thought it had always had one.
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.hat_q.voice_text: Agata, did you draw the bird's cap? Really? I thought it had always had one.

ulyana:O1d.ulyana.lights_b.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.lights_b.text: Only a year passed for you? Granny says time is the same for everyone now. Does that mean no one will get lost for twenty years again?
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.lights_b.voice_text: Only a year passed for you? Granny says time is the same for everyone now. Does that mean no one will get lost for twenty years again?

ulyana:O1d.ulyana.lights_q.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.lights_q.text: Uncle Mitya took a lantern to the pier every evening. I thought he was talking to the river.
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.lights_q.voice_text: Uncle Mitya took a lantern to the pier every evening. I thought he was talking to the river.

ulyana:O1d.ulyana.ttt_a.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.ttt_a.text: Yes! I get noughts. You have crosses, so you go first.
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.ttt_a.voice_text: Yes! I get noughts. You have crosses, so you go first.

ulyana:O1d.ulyana.ttt_bye.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.ttt_bye.text: All right. We'll play again tomorrow — and I'll go first!
ulyana:O1d.ulyana.ttt_bye.voice_text: All right. We'll play again tomorrow — and I'll go first!

ulyana:O1q.village_map.ulyana_apple.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O1q.village_map.ulyana_apple.text: And an apple tree! Papa planted it when I was born.
ulyana:O1q.village_map.ulyana_apple.voice_text: And an apple tree! Papa planted it when I was born.

ulyana:O1q.village_map.ulyana_ours.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O1q.village_map.ulyana_ours.text: But that's our garden! On your map there's only a fence behind our house.
ulyana:O1q.village_map.ulyana_ours.voice_text: But that's our garden! On your map there's only a fence behind our house.

ulyana:O1q.village_map.ulyana_route.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O1q.village_map.ulyana_route.text: Take the road down from the school. Our house is the very last one. The garden's behind it, where your map is blank.
ulyana:O1q.village_map.ulyana_route.voice_text: Take the road down from the school. Our house is the very last one. The garden's behind it, where your map is blank.

ulyana:O3.ulyana.after.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:O3.ulyana.after.text: Has it really only been a year for you? I'm eight already!
ulyana:O3.ulyana.after.voice_text: Has it really only been a year for you? I'm eight already!

ulyana:mech.ttt.draw.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:mech.ttt.draw.text: A draw. Papa and I always draw, too.
ulyana:mech.ttt.draw.voice_text: A draw. Papa and I always draw, too.

ulyana:mech.ttt.lose.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:mech.ttt.lose.text: I won! Three noughts in a row!
ulyana:mech.ttt.lose.voice_text: I won! Three noughts in a row!

ulyana:mech.ttt.win.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:mech.ttt.win.text: Oh, you beat me! Again — I'll go first this time.
ulyana:mech.ttt.win.voice_text: Oh, you beat me! Again — I'll go first this time.

ulyana:mech.village_map.wrong.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:mech.village_map.wrong.text: Not there! Start again. From the school to our house, then to the garden.
ulyana:mech.village_map.wrong.voice_text: Not there! Start again. From the school to our house, then to the garden.

ulyana:mech.village_map.wrong_again.speaker: ulyana
ulyana:mech.village_map.wrong_again.text: Not here. Back to the school again.
ulyana:mech.village_map.wrong_again.voice_text: Not here. Back to the school again.
